name: Security Token (CMTA — German & Swiss profiles)
description: Programmable asset tokens designed as reference profiles for the CMTA framework, supporting the implementation of German (eWpG) and Swiss (OR, ledger-based securities) requirements. Provides KYC-gated transfers, denylisting, global pause, forced transfers and seizures, supply caps, role-based permissions and an irreversible decommission mechanism, plus a SecurityInfo metadata schema covering ISIN, terms of issue, issuer details, nominal amount and register/custodian references. Technical functionality only — it does not imply or ensure legal or regulatory compliance in any jurisdiction.
